chunks: From him, from Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir (from Abu Ja'far) in a tradition of his which we have summarized,

He said: When the Qaim (peace be upon him) arises, he will enter Kufa and order the demolition of the four mosques until their foundations are reached, making them like the canopies of Musa (peace be upon him). The mosques will all be plain, without upper stories or additions, as they were in the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family). He will widen the main highway to sixty cubits, demolish every mosque on the road, and block every window, balcony, latrine, and gutter facing the road. Allah will command the heavens in his time to slow their rotation, so that a day in his time is like ten of your days, a month like ten of your months, and a year like ten of your years.

He will not remain long before the rebels from the Mawali emerge from Rumaylat al-Daskara, ten thousand in number, their slogan being: 'O Uthman, O Uthman!' He will summon one of the Mawali, attach a sword to his waist, and go out to them, killing them until not one remains. Then he will turn to Kabul Shah, a city that no one else has ever conquered, and he will conquer it. After that, he will return to Kufa, make it his residence, and defeat seventy Arab tribes… The end of the narration.

key_terms.الذِّرَاع: Cubit, a unit of measurement used here to describe the width of the main highway
key_terms.الْفَلَك: The Heaven/Sphere, referring to the celestial bodies whose rotation slows down during the Imam's era
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Qaim, a title for the Twelfth Imam indicating his rising to establish justice
key_terms.الْكُوفَةُ: Kufa, a major city in Iraq often associated with the Imam's residence and governance
key_terms.جِمَاءً: Plain or simple, referring to mosques without added upper floors or decorations
key_terms.رُمَيْلَةُ الدَّسْكِرَة: Rumaylat al-Daskara, a specific location or hamlet mentioned as the origin of the rebels
key_terms.كَابُلَ شَاه: Kabul Shah, a city noted for being conquered uniquely by the Imam
key_terms.مَارِقَةُ الْمَوَالِي: Rebels from the Mawali (non-Arab converts), specifically those claiming the legacy of Uthman

ai.seo_question: What are the physical and cosmic signs associated with the rise of the Qaim Imam according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* outlines the Qaim’s urban reforms in Kufa, specifically the demolition of added structures to restore the mosques' original simplicity as seen in the Prophet’s time, reflecting the Shia emphasis on purifying worship spaces from later innovations. It further details cosmic time dilation during his reign and his military campaigns against the 'Marqa' (rebels) and the conquest of Kabul, establishing Kufa as his capital. These events underscore the transition from occultation to visible governance, marked by both spiritual purification and political consolidation.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 498 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Abdur Rahman bin Abu Hashim from Ali bin Abu Hamza from Abu Basir that he said in a tradition and we summarized it:

“When the Qaim arises he would enter Kufa. Then he would order razing the four mosques upto their foundations and make them like the canopies of Musa (a.s) and demolish the additions and additional floors till they return to the form that they were in at the time of the Holy Prophet (s). He will widen the main highways to 60 yards in width. Any Masjid that comes on the way would be demolished. He will shut down all openings, balconies and structures jutting out to the main road. The Almighty Allah would command the heavens to reduce their rotation during the tenure of his rule, thus a day of that time would be equal to ten days of your period, one month equal to ten months of yours, and one year equal to ten years of your time.

Not much time would pass that ten thousand rebels would emerge from the hamlet of Rameela and their slogan would be: O Uthman, O Uthman. His Eminence would summon one of his men and attach a sword to his waist. He would slay the whole crowd single-handed and not one of them would be spared. After that His Eminence would turn to Kabul Shah. It is a city that no one has ever conquered, but he would conquer it. After that he would return to Kufa and reside there after eliminating seventy Arab tribes…”
